primitives.name: Hurdling Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: Hurdling, as used in the rules, applies only to the man carrying the ball.
primitives.assumptions: (1) Only the ball carrier can perform a legal hurdle; (2) The defender must be upright; (3) The action occurs within defined spatial zones.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularity at simultaneous airborne contact without clear trajectory.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI conformal prediction regions for spatial collision events.
layer2.telemetry: Observed airborne trajectories and ground reaction forces.

primitives.name: Down State Transition
primitives.verbatim_quote: A Down occurs when the Referee blows his whistle or declares the ball dead.
primitives.assumptions: (1) The referee's signal is instantaneous; (2) The ball immediately loses momentum upon signal.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Temporal overlap between whistle and physical ball deceleration.

layer2.mapping: Serves as a boundary condition for GSE Markov decision processes.
layer2.telemetry: Audio latency of whistle to ball velocity drop.

primitives.name: Ball Death Predicate
primitives.verbatim_quote: The Ball is Dead (and no play can be made with it except according to rule): When the Referee blows his whistle or declares that a down, fair catch, touchdown, touchback, safety or goal has been made.
primitives.assumptions: (1) Dead-ball states are mutually exclusive; (2) The referee's declaration is definitive.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Edge case where multiple conditions trigger simultaneously.

layer2.mapping: Conforms to GSI event-type classification for betting markets.
layer2.telemetry: Frame-by-frame video analysis of dead-ball triggers.
